note: Drafted, never applied or run. Every from string is a single line copied from the current file and occurs exactly once in it (recounted 2026-10-08 after the round-3 fixes; G6's from was stale, since the R2 fix renamed the deactivation's membership read from `membership` to `current`, and now names the current line); several of these files use CRLF line endings, so no from string spans a line break. The permission-template guards are the same line in five functions, so each of those mutations edits the function's own unique signature line instead: it adds a destructured parameter named `require` whose default answers "./membership.service" with a no-op assertAccessExpansionAllowed and hands every other id to module.require, which disables that one function's guard and nothing else (G17 does the same to createApiClient, spreading the real module so its later findUserInOrg/findMembership still resolve). mutate-multi.js needs a LISTS entry before it reads this file: guards: ['scripts/cert/cert3/d-id-1-guards-proof.js', true]. Round 4 (2026-10-08): G19 re-anchored (see its reanchored field); G22-G28 added for the round-4 checks P.race.off/P.race.on/P.race.key, U.admin-snapshot, U.mirror.held, O.race, E.midflight and F.create-off; G25 and G19 both edit updateUser's signature line, which is unique, and each is applied on its own.
